def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for v in counts if v != bg] if bg == 0 else [0]
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        # Continue pairs of diagonal points in their observed direction.
        for i, (r1,c1) in enumerate(pts):
            for r2,c2 in pts[i+1:]:
                dr,dc=r2-r1,c2-c1
                if abs(dr)==abs(dc) and dr != 0:
                    # Continue the aligned diagonal in both directions, stopping at borders.
                    for sign in (-1,1):
                        rr,cc=r1-sign*(1 if dr>0 else -1), c1-sign*(1 if dc>0 else -1)
                        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                            if out[rr][cc] == bg: out[rr][cc]=color
                            rr-=sign*(1 if dr>0 else -1); cc-=sign*(1 if dc>0 else -1)
                    break
            else: continue
            break
    return out
